name: feature-workflow
description: End-to-end feature development workflow with Clean Architecture. Works on both new and existing codebases. Supports React/Next.js web, Node/Express backend, and Flutter/Dart mobile. Includes intelligent codebase analysis, cached project understanding, token-efficient incremental scanning, safe legacy development, multi-database support, Flutter state management (BLoC/Riverpod/Provider), infrastructure setup, credential management, multi-target deployment (web + mobile app stores), product management, team coordination, and session continuity.
